        // The admin theme's table plugin rebuilds the table rows after this script has run,\n
        // which drops listeners bound to the buttons inside them, so every handler listens\n
        // on the document. (Bound directly, the confirmations below were silently skipped.)\n
        var saveTemplateUrl = "http:\/\/localhost\/admin\/funnels\/__ID__\/save-as-template";\n
        document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {\n
            var button = event.target.closest('[data-save-template]');\n
            if (!button) return;\n
            document.getElementById('funnel-save-template-form').action = saveTemplateUrl.replace('__ID__', button.getAttribute('data-save-template'));\n
            document.getElementById('funnel-save-template-name').value = button.getAttribute('data-name') || '';\n
            $('#funnel-save-template').modal('show');\n
        });\n
        // Copies the live address; where the clipboard is not available (plain http) the address is shown to copy by hand.\n
        document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {\n
            var button = event.target.closest('.funnel-copy');\n
            if (!button) return;\n
            var url = button.getAttribute('data-url');\n
            var label = button.getAttribute('data-label') || button.textContent;\n
            button.setAttribute('data-label', label);\n
            var done = function () { button.textContent = button.getAttribute('data-done'); setTimeout(function () { button.textContent = label; }, 1500); };\n
            if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) navigator.clipboard.writeText(url).then(done, function () { window.prompt('', url); });\n
            else window.prompt('', url);\n
        });\n
        // Confirmation text lives in data-confirm rather than inline JS, so a\n
        // translated message containing quotes cannot break the handler.\n
        document.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {\n
            var form = event.target.closest('.funnel-actions form[data-confirm]');\n
            if (form && !window.confirm(form.getAttribute('data-confirm'))) {\n
                event.preventDefault();\n
            }\n
        });\n
